video_title: EMERGENCY POD: Jaylen Brown Traded To Philadelphia 76ers! | KOC Live

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown traded to the 76ers for Paul George and picks
quotes.excerpt: I cannot believe Jaylen Brown only went to the Philadelphia 76ers for two first-round draft picks
quotes.quote: I cannot believe Jaylen Brown only went to the Philadelphia 76ers for two first-round draft picks, two second-round picks, and Paul George. Are you kidding me? Are you serious? This is it? That's it? The Celtics got less than the Jazz got for Walker Kessler. Are you kidding me? I guess it wasn't just about teams trying to leverage their way into giving less to Boston. Nobody likes Jaylen Brown. Simple as that, that's the clear takeaway here. Bobby Marks was right: seventh best player on a team.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers upgrade from Paul George to Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: What an upgrade to go from what was called an albatross contract, Paul George, old, injury-prone, in his mid-30s
quotes.quote: What an upgrade to go from what was called an albatross contract, Paul George, old, injury-prone, in his mid-30s, diminished shell of his former self, and you turn him into Jaylen Brown, a guy who just finished sixth in MVP voting. It is truly hard to fathom that this is what the Philadelphia 76ers pulled off. Hell of an off-season so far for their new general manager, Mike Gansey. Signs Dean Wade, who is in my opinion a very underrated free agent, a big forward, big versatile defender, can do enough on the offensive end of the floor as well. And then you upgrade from Paul George to Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens' decision to trade Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I've been a Brad Stevens supporter for a long time and I still do believe in him
quotes.quote: I've been a Brad Stevens supporter for a long time and I still do believe in him. I think there's an element of this where we are going to learn more in time. There's been reporting around how Jaylen Brown didn't demand a trade. I don't know, maybe he did, maybe he didn't. We'll find out more in the coming days and weeks, I'm sure. But there must be something we don't know here. There has to be, because only two firsts and two seconds and Paul George for Jaylen Brown is a major shock.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Dan Wolken's criticism of the Celtics' trade
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to fathom how badly the Celtics botched this. Holy moly.
quotes.quote: It's hard to fathom how badly the Celtics botched this. Holy moly. This is a Finals MVP, a guy who finished sixth in MVP voting, has improved every single season of his career. Yes, he can be a little annoying. Yes, he does the Twitch streaming and he says too much. That's all true. And yes, he's a flawed star as well. He doesn't playmake enough. He doesn't necessarily make his teammates better as a passer. He's not the most efficient player, but the dude plays with no fear. He's got heart, he's tough, he's physical, he's a two-way player, can get downhill, can score from anywhere on the floor, a versatile defensive player, and he's an additive piece for the Philadelphia 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the Celtics' perspective on the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: Let's say you are the biggest Jaylen Brown fan. You clearly would hate this trade today.
quotes.quote: Let's say you are the biggest Jaylen Brown fan. You clearly would hate this trade today. Let's say you are a member of the Celtics front office and you view this trade as a win, you are happy with the return. What would your reasoning be if you're Brad Stevens and you're happy with this trade or you're a member of the Celtics front office and you're happy with this trade and you think everybody else is taking crazy pills? So let's, I know everybody in the chat disagrees and thinks the 76ers win this trade in a landslide, but what if, what if the Celtics are right? Okay, so let's just think through that as a thought exercise here. What if they're right?

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' potential mistake in the Giannis Antetokounmpo pursuit
quotes.excerpt: I think this is a mistake and it's very clear they may have botched this entire off-season
quotes.quote: I think this is a mistake and it's very clear they may have botched this entire off-season by going to the one-yard line for Giannis Antetokounmpo and being not willing to put Ugo Gonzalez and Baylor Scheierman and that extra pick, whatever the demand was from Milwaukee, they were unwilling to do it. By being unwilling to put those pieces on the table, they put themselves in this position to go from Giannis Antetokounmpo to Paul George. So I think it's a loss. However, everything we just said about what would the argument be for Boston if they actually ended up winning this deal, like if that's the way it plays out, if Boston won the deal, I think it would be everything I just said regarding the efficiency.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' lack of interest in Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I reported this like a month ago when the Giannis Boston stuff was first out there
quotes.quote: I reported this like a month ago when the Giannis Boston stuff was first out there and people were talking about the Bucks sending Jaylen Brown to a third team. I reported at the time that the Atlanta Hawks didn't have as much interest in Jaylen Brown as people thought they did. And the reason why was because of the money. They didn't want to pay him $60 million the next three years and they were largely worried about that next contract, the next deal when he's 33 years old and eligible for a five-year supermax contract at that point. That's the deal Atlanta was more so worried about when I said that. And that was specifically the Atlanta Hawks that I was reporting on when I said that. But I believe that to be true with other teams as well.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential documentary or series
quotes.excerpt: My sources say LeBron James has had some discussions about filming this entire upcoming season
quotes.quote: My sources say LeBron James has had some discussions about filming this entire upcoming season either for a documentary or a series, like a Netflix series, a weekly episode or something like that that drops. I believe that LeBron is always basically had his career filmed, cameras have always followed him around. So I'm sure they're planning for something post-career, but it sounds like they want to do something pretty big, pretty big for this season. And I don't know if that's going to rule out some teams. I'm sure some teams wouldn't want that to happen.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Nikola Jokic's potential team-up
quotes.excerpt: Let's say that was a real thing, a real conversation with Jokic's agent. Jokic hasn't signed the extension.
quotes.quote: Let's say that was a real thing, a real conversation with Jokic's agent. Jokic hasn't signed the extension. LeBron James opted out of the Lakers. Could LeBron go to Denver? Team up with Jokic for a year and then from here they launch their league where they're investors, they have equity. If LeBron and Jokic are the face of this league and they're touring the world, playing basketball on a lower salary of course, but with far more significant upside with the equity they have in that league, I'm just speculating, but we have reason to speculate considering that Jokic's own agent posted a photo a year ago with Mav Carter, LeBron's longtime business partner, Maverick Carter. The caption said, the summer of 2025 is the perfect time to make big plans for the fall of 2026. This conversation in all likelihood was about Project B, and that's the proposed league that's going to feature six men's and six women's teams that are going to tour the globe, film the story behind the scenes.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers, of course, everything the non-LeBron stuff with the Lakers, of course. They signed Mamu
quotes.quote: The Lakers, of course, everything the non-LeBron stuff with the Lakers, of course. They signed Mamu, they signed Walker Kessler, they signed Colin Sexton and Quentin Grimes. I don't love it all to be totally honest with you for the Lakers. I don't love it all, and the reason why is this: individually, I like Mamu. I think Mamu is one of the most underrated players in all of basketball. He is a 6'9" shot creator, three-point shooter, hustle guy. I really like Mamu. Colin Sexton, I'm intrigued. 40% shooter from three, speedy, can get to the rim. He's tough, hard-nosed guy, a little undersized. I like Sexton individually. Quentin Grimes, he's okay, nothing special. Up and down, one night he's awesome, one night he's terrible. The next three weeks he's incredible, he looks like a star. The next three weeks he's just get him off the floor. He's so up and down, highs and lows swings. You never know what version of Quentin Grimes you're going to get. Very annoying. Walker Kessler, individually, I love Walker Kessler. I think for the money, four years, $130 million is a pretty solid value contract for Walker Kessler, given he is such a great rim protector, a lob guy, a perfect threat with Luka Doncic. However, two first-round draft picks and two pick swaps for Walker Kessler, that's a big, big risk for a guy who's had some durability issues.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Denver Nuggets would not want Jaylen Brown in a trade
quotes.excerpt: Denver could not get Jaylen Brown, I would not want Jaylen Brown if I were Denver.
quotes.quote: Denver could not get Jaylen Brown, I would not want Jaylen Brown if I were Denver.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis needs to start for the Boston Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I do think he needs to start, get his scoring in there.
quotes.quote: I do think he needs to start, get his scoring in there.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating if the Jaylen Brown trade is the worst since Luka
quotes.excerpt: I think it is a bad trade for Boston and it might go down as a horrible trade.
quotes.quote: I think it is a bad trade for Boston and it might go down as a horrible trade. It could be a little bit better than worst trade ever if we are just being totally honest here.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics originally wanted Jalen Duren in the trade
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics were originally asking the Sixers to include Jalen Duren.
quotes.quote: The Celtics were originally asking the Sixers to include Jalen Duren. Of course they were, and of course they did not get him. That is no surprise.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons are waiting for clarity on Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: I think the Jalen Duren camp is waiting for clarity on what the Pistons want to do.
quotes.quote: I think the Jalen Duren camp is waiting for clarity on what the Pistons want to do. I believe the Pistons are going to match anything that is out there. Any offer sheet that he signs, they would match it. But I think Jalen Duren's camp is hoping for a sign and trade for a team to meet the threshold that Detroit would deem acceptable.

quotes.speaker: Kevin O'Connor
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons lack a clear replacement center
quotes.excerpt: All the good centers in free agency are pretty much gone at this point.
quotes.quote: All the good centers in free agency are pretty much gone at this point. Look at the list: Andre Drummond, Nick Richards, Dwight Powell, Kevin Love, Bismack Biyombo, Drew Eubanks, Quentin Grimes, Mason Plumlee, Tony Bradley. There is nothing there. So who is your center if you are Detroit?
